note: flp_build_rise (flh_rise): the orchestral / piano build into a climax. A user file <fl-headless state folder>/rise/rise.json wins key by key. ladders: roman numerals (flh_compose grammar; minor keys count from the natural minor scale, so #vii is the raised leading tone) spread evenly over the build bars - diminished 7ths a minor third / step apart that land on a suspended dominant holding the breath before the new section's tonic. tempo.push: the accelerando starts this fraction under the tempo and ends this fraction over it (times intensity). dynamics: the crescendo's target velocities at the build's start and end (end = from + (to - from) * intensity). roll: beats of the swell into the downbeat (short_beats when intensity < 0.75), strokes per second of a roll, the first stroke's velocity, the downbeat strike over the crescendo's top. low_strings: bars they hold from the downbeat, velocity as a share of the crescendo's top, register (sounding MIDI notes), and for a song without one: the new channel's name and the data/templates recipe whose 'Low Strings' channel choices pick its owned instrument (else a copy of the song's strings channel). words: channel names / plugins / samples that mark the roll and low-strings instruments.
